notes.subject: moya
notes.rationale: נפש ke moya/botshelo — sengwalwa sa motho yo a hemago, e sego 'moya' wa semoyeng fela

notes.subject: who hastens with his feet
notes.rationale: ואץ ברגלים: ba bangwe ba bolela 'yo a ikgantšhago ka maoto', ba bangwe 'yo a sepelago kapejana' — BSB e bolela 'zeal without knowledge'

notes.subject: go se se nago tsebo ga go a botse
notes.rationale: Polelo e ka boela e be: 'tsebo ye e sego gona ga e šome' — sebopego sa Seheberu se bulela dikakgelō tše pedi

translation: Gomme moya wo o se nago ⟨tsebo⟩ ga o a botse; gomme yo a ikgantšhago ka maoto o dira sebe.
